The CPN catheter site is a potential source for introduction 
of microorganisms into a major vein. Protocols to prevent in-
fection vary and should follow Centers for Disease Control 
Prevention guidelines (Naomi et al, 2011). Catheter care and 
prevention of catheter-related bloodstream infections are of 
utmost importance in the hospital and alternate settings. These 
infections not only are costly but also may be life-threatening. 
Catheter care is dictated by the site of the catheter and the 
setting in which the patient receives care.
